'''Ramalla Ash'yn''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and resident of [[Kessan's Landing]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. She became aware that [[Hidden Chain]] members had sabotaged the [[Subterranean Power Station]] near [[Port Granost]], and grew concerned since without the power, the port would become useless as a resupply point. Unable to fight the Hidden Chain members herself, she asked an individual to repair the power station for her, which they did.<ref name="TOR:TtLO"/>
